title: BusinessMath Model Context Protocol Tool Manifest (Excerpt)
description: Definitive schema for all 68 exposed BusinessMath computational tools, categorized by function. Adherence to these input schemas is mandatory for tool invocation.

tools.name: calculate_present_value
tools.description: Calculate the present value of a future amount given an interest rate and number of periods. PV = FV / (1 + r)^n

rate.description: The interest rate per period (e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

tools.name: calculate_future_value
tools.description: Calculate the future value of a present amount given an interest rate and number of periods. FV = PV × (1 + r)^n

rate.description: The interest rate per period (e.05 for 5%)

tools.name: calculate_npv
tools.description: Calculate Net Present Value for a series of cash flows. NPV = Σ(CF_t / (1 + r)^t) - Initial Investment

rate.description: The discount rate per period (e.g., 0.10 for 10%)

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows (first is typically the initial investment as a negative number)

tools.name: calculate_irr
tools.description: Calculate Internal Rate of Return for a series of cash flows. IRR is the discount rate that makes NPV = 0

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows (first is typically the initial investment as a negative number)

tools.name: calculate_payment
tools.description: Calculate the periodic payment for a loan or annuity given present value, interest rate, and number of periods

presentValue.description: The loan amount or present value

rate.description: The interest rate per period (e.g., 0.004167 for 5% annual rate with monthly payments)

periods.description: The total number of payment periods

type.description: Payment timing: 'ordinary' (end of period) or 'due' (beginning of period)

tools.name: calculate_annuity_pv
tools.description: Calculate the present value of an annuity (series of equal payments)

type.description: Payment timing: 'ordinary' (end of period) or 'due' (beginning of period)

tools.name: calculate_annuity_fv
tools.description: Calculate the future value of an annuity (series of equal payments)

type.description: Payment timing: 'ordinary' (end of period) or 'due' (beginning of period)

tools.name: calculate_xnpv
tools.description: Calculate Net Present Value for irregular cash flows with specific dates. Use this when cash flows occur at irregular intervals (not annually). REQUIRED STRUCTURE includes cashFlows array of objects containing 'date' in ISO 8601 format and 'amount'.

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flow objects. Each object must have: • date (string): ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z") • amount (number): Cash flow amount (negative for outflows, positive for inflows)

tools.name: calculate_xirr
tools.description: Calculate Internal Rate of Return for irregular cash flows with specific dates. REQUIRED STRUCTURE includes cashFlows array of objects containing 'date' in ISO 8601 format and 'amount'.

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flow objects with exact dates. Each object must have: • date (string): ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z") • amount (number): Cash flow amount (first should be negative investment) Must include at least one negative and one positive cash flow.

guess.description: Initial guess for XIRR (default: 0.1 for 10%). Only needed if calculation fails to converge.

tools.name: calculate_asset_turnover
tools.description: Calculate the asset turnover ratio. Formula: Net Sales / Average Total Assets.

netSales.description: Net sales or revenue for the period

averageTotalAssets.description: Average total assets during the period (beginning + ending) / 2

tools.name: calculate_current_ratio
tools.description: Calculate the current ratio (liquidity ratio). Formula: Current Assets / Current Liabilities

currentAssets.description: Total current assets (cash, receivables, inventory, etc.)

currentLiabilities.description: Total current liabilities (payables, short-term debt, etc.)

tools.name: calculate_quick_ratio
tools.description: Calculate the quick ratio (acid-test ratio). Formula: (Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities

tools.name: calculate_debt_to_equity
tools.description: Calculate the debt to equity ratio (leverage ratio). Formula: Total Liabilities / Shareholder Equity

tools.name: calculate_interest_coverage
tools.description: Calculate the interest coverage ratio (times interest earned). Formula: EBIT / Interest Expense

earningsBeforeInterestAndTax.description: EBIT - Earnings before interest and taxes (operating income)

interestExpense.description: Total interest expense for the period

tools.name: calculate_inventory_turnover
tools.description: Calculate the inventory turnover ratio. Formula: Cost of Goods Sold / Average Inventory.

costOfGoodsSold.description: Total cost of goods sold for the period

tools.name: calculate_profit_margin
tools.description: Calculate the profit margin (Net Margin). Formula: Net Income / Total Revenue.

netIncome.description: Net income (profit after all expenses and taxes)

tools.name: calculate_roe
tools.description: Calculate Return on Equity (ROE). Formula: Net Income / Shareholder Equity.

tools.name: calculate_roi
tools.description: Calculate Return on Investment (ROI). Formula: Gain from Investment / Cost of Investment.

gainFromInvestment.description: Total gain or return from the investment

tools.name: calculate_earnings_per_share
tools.description: Calculate Earnings Per Share (EPS). Formula: Net Income / Shares Outstanding.

netIncome.description: Net income (profit after all expenses and taxes)

tools.name: calculate_book_value_per_share
tools.description: Calculate Book Value Per Share (BVPS). Formula: Total Shareholder Equity / Shares Outstanding.

tools.name: calculate_price_to_earnings
tools.description: Calculate Price-to-Earnings Ratio (P/E). Formula: Market Price per Share / Earnings per Share.

tools.name: calculate_price_to_book
tools.description: Calculate Price-to-Book Ratio (P/B). Formula: Market Price per Share / Book Value per Share.

tools.name: calculate_price_to_sales
tools.description: Calculate Price-to-Sales Ratio (P/S). Formula: Market Cap / Total Revenue.

tools.name: calculate_market_cap
tools.description: Calculate Market Capitalization. Formula: Share Price × Shares Outstanding.

tools.name: calculate_enterprise_value
tools.description: Calculate Enterprise Value (EV). Formula: EV = Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents.

tools.name: calculate_ev_to_ebitda
tools.description: Calculate EV/EBITDA ratio. Formula: Enterprise Value / EBITDA. Capital-structure-neutral valuation metric.

ebitda.description: EBITDA (Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization)

tools.name: calculate_ev_to_sales
tools.description: Calculate EV/Sales ratio. Formula: Enterprise Value / Total Revenue.

tools.name: calculate_working_capital
tools.description: Calculate Working Capital. Formula: Current Assets - Current Liabilities. Measures short-term liquidity buffer.

tools.name: calculate_debt_to_assets
tools.description: Calculate Debt-to-Assets Ratio. Formula: Total Debt / Total Assets. Shows proportion of assets financed by debt.

tools.name: calculate_free_cash_flow
tools.description: Calculate Free Cash Flow (FCF). Formula: Operating Cash Flow - Capital Expenditures. Cash available after maintaining assets.

tools.name: create_amortization_schedule
tools.description: Generate a complete amortization schedule for a loan showing payment breakdown by period.

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate as decimal (e.g., 0.065 for 6.5%)

showFullSchedule.description: Show full schedule (true) or summary with first/last payments (false, default)

tools.name: calculate_wacc
tools.description: Calculate the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC).

costOfEquity.description: Cost of equity capital as decimal (e.g., 0.12 for 12%)

costOfDebt.description: Cost of debt before tax as decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

taxRate.description: Corporate tax rate as decimal (e.g., 0.25 for 25%)

tools.name: calculate_capm
tools.description: Calculate the expected return on equity using the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM).

riskFreeRate.description: Risk-free rate as decimal (e.g., 0.03 for 3% T-bill rate)

beta.description: Beta coefficient (systematic risk). 1.0 = market risk, >1.0 = more volatile, <1.0 = less volatile

marketReturn.description: Expected market return as decimal (e.g., 0.10 for 10%)

tools.name: calculate_dscr
tools.description: Calculate the Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR). DSCR = Net Operating Income / Total Debt Service.

totalDebtService.description: Total annual debt service (principal + interest payments)

tools.name: calculate_altman_z_score
tools.description: Calculate the Altman Z-Score for bankruptcy prediction (Z > 2.99 = Safe, < 1.81 = Distress).

marketValueEquity.description: Market value of equity (for public companies) or book value (for private)

tools.name: compare_financing_options
tools.description: Compare multiple financing options (loans, leases, equity) side-by-side based on total cost, monthly payment, and effective annual rate.

option1Rate.description: Annual rate for option 1 as decimal

option2Rate.description: Annual rate for option 2 as decimal

tools.name: calculate_principal_payment
tools.description: Calculate the principal portion of a specific loan payment (Excel PPMT equivalent).

interestRate.description: Interest rate per period (e.g., 0.05/12 for 5% annual rate with monthly payments)

period.description: The specific payment period to analyze (1-indexed, e.g., 1 for first payment)

totalPeriods.description: Total number of payment periods (e.g., 360 for 30-year monthly mortgage)

balloonPayment.description: Optional balloon payment at end (future value, default: 0)

paymentTiming.description: When payments occur: 'ordinary' (end of period, default) or 'due' (start of period)

tools.name: calculate_interest_payment
tools.description: Calculate the interest portion of a specific loan payment (Excel IPMT equivalent).

interestRate.description: Interest rate per period (e.g., 0.04/12 for 4% annual rate with monthly payments)

period.description: The specific payment period to analyze (1-indexed)

tools.name: calculate_cumulative_interest
tools.description: Calculate total interest paid over a range of loan payments (Excel CUMIPMT).

startPeriod.description: First period to include (1-indexed, e.g., 1 for first payment)

endPeriod.description: Last period to include (e.g., 12 for first year if monthly)

totalPeriods.description: Total number of payment periods in loan

tools.name: calculate_cumulative_principal
tools.description: Calculate total principal paid over a range of loan payments (Excel CUMPRINC).

totalPeriods.description: Total number of payment periods in loan

tools.name: calculate_profitability_index
tools.description: Calculate Profitability Index (PI). PI > 1: Accept project (positive NPV).

discountRate.description: Discount rate per period (e.g., 0.10 for 10% annual rate)

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows where negative = investments, positive = returns. First element is typically initial investment at t=0.

tools.name: calculate_payback_period
tools.description: Calculate payback period (undiscounted) for investment recovery analysis.

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows. First element is typically negative (initial investment at t=0).

tools.name: calculate_discounted_payback_period
tools.description: Calculate discounted payback period with time value of money.

discountRate.description: Discount rate per period (e.g., 0.10 for 10% annual rate)

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows. First element is typically initial investment at t=0.

tools.name: calculate_mirr
tools.description: Calculate Modified Internal Rate of Return (MIRR) for realistic return analysis, using separate finance and reinvestment rates.

cashFlows.description: Array of cash flows (negative = investments/outflows, positive = returns/inflows). First element is typically initial investment at t=0.

financeRate.description: Rate at which negative cash flows (investments) are financed - typically cost of capital or borrowing rate (e.g., 0.08 for 8%)

reinvestmentRate.description: Rate at which positive cash flows (returns) are reinvested - typically market rate or alternative investment return (e.g., 0.06 for 6%)

tools.name: calculate_growth_rate
tools.description: Calculate the growth rate between two values

tools.name: calculate_cagr
tools.description: Calculate the Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) between two values over a period

tools.name: apply_growth_projection
tools.description: Project future values by applying a growth rate with specified compounding frequency. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires baseValue, annualGrowthRate, and periods.

annualGrowthRate.description: Annual growth rate as decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% growth)

periods.description: Number of periods to project (interpretation depends on compounding frequency)

metricName.description: Optional name for the metric being projected (e.g., 'Revenue', 'Customers')

tools.name: create_time_series
tools.description: Create a time series from periods and values for analysis. REQUIRED STRUCTURE details the nested period object structure including 'year', 'month'/'day' (optional), and 'type' (enum: "annual", "quarterly", "monthly", or "daily").

data.description: Array of time series data points. Each object must have: • period (object): Time period with fields: - year (number) - month (number) - day (number) - type (string): "annual", "quarterly", "monthly", or "daily" • value (number): Numeric value for this period

tools.name: time_series_statistics
tools.description: Calculate descriptive statistics for a time series (mean, median, std dev, min, max)

tools.name: calculate_moving_average
tools.description: Calculate a moving average for a time series

window.description: The window size for the moving average

tools.name: aggregate_time_series
tools.description: Aggregate time series data (sum, mean, min, max)

tools.name: fit_linear_trend
tools.description: Fit a linear trend model to time series data. Returns slope, intercept, and R-squared. Requires 'data' as an array of TimeSeries objects.

data.description: Time series data with periods and values

tools.name: fit_exponential_trend
tools.description: Fit an exponential trend model to time series data. Requires 'data' as an array of TimeSeries objects.

data.description: Time series data with periods and values (all values must be positive)

tools.name: fit_logistic_trend
tools.description: Fit a logistic (S-curve) trend model to time series data. Models growth that approaches a maximum capacity.

data.description: Time series data with periods and values

capacity.description: Maximum capacity (L parameter) - the upper asymptote

tools.name: forecast_trend
tools.description: Project a fitted trend model forward for specified periods. Must fit a trend model first.

data.description: Original time series data that was fitted

trendType.description: Type of trend model to use

periods.description: Number of periods to forecast forward

tools.name: calculate_seasonal_indices
tools.description: Calculate seasonal indices from time series data. Indices show the typical pattern for each season.

data.description: Time series data with at least 2 complete years

periodsPerYear.description: Number of periods in a year (4 for quarterly, 12 for monthly)

tools.name: seasonally_adjust
tools.description: Remove seasonal patterns from time series data using seasonal indices. This reveals the underlying trend.

tools.name: decompose_time_series
tools.description: Decompose time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components. Decomposition method must be 'additive' or 'multiplicative'.

data.description: Time series data with at least 2 complete years

periodsPerYear.description: Number of periods in a year (4 for quarterly, 12 for monthly)

method.description: Decomposition method: 'additive' (for constant seasonal variation) or 'multiplicative' (for proportional variation)

tools.name: forecast_with_seasonality
tools.description: Create a complete forecast combining trend projection and seasonal patterns. Trend type must be 'linear' or 'exponential'.

periodsPerYear.description: Number of periods in a year (4 for quarterly, 12 for monthly)

trendType.description: Type of trend to use for projection

tools.name: forecast_linear_trend
tools.description: Forecast future values using linear trend analysis. Assumes constant rate of change.

historicalValues.description: Array of historical data values (at least 2 values required)

forecastPeriods.description: Number of periods to forecast into the future

tools.name: forecast_exponential_trend
tools.description: Forecast future values using exponential trend analysis (accelerating/decelerating growth).

historicalValues.description: Array of historical data values (must be positive, at least 2 values)

tools.name: forecast_logistic_trend
tools.description: Forecast future values using logistic trend (S-curve with saturation). Note: Requires capacity parameter.

historicalValues.description: Array of historical data values (at least 3 values)

capacity.description: Maximum capacity (L parameter) - the saturation point

tools.name: create_distribution
tools.description: Create a probability distribution for Monte Carlo simulation. Supports 15 distributions. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires 'type' and 'parameters' object detailing required inputs (e.g., {mean, stdDev} for normal).

parameters.description: Distribution parameters (varies by type, e.g., {mean, stdDev} for normal, {min, max, mode} for triangular, {degreesOfFreedom} for t/chi-squared)

sampleSize.description: Number of sample values to generate for verification (default: 10)

tools.name: run_monte_carlo
tools.description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation to model uncertainty and risk. REQUIRED STRUCTURE clearly defines the 'inputs' array (name, distribution, parameters) and the 'calculation' string using input placeholders {0}, {1}, etc.

inputs.description: Array of uncertain input variables. Each object must have: • name (string) • distribution (string) (Supports: normal, uniform, triangular) • parameters (object)

calculation.description: Formula combining inputs using {0}, {1}, {2}, etc. Example: "{0} - {1}" (Revenue - Costs)

tools.name: analyze_simulation_results
tools.description: Perform detailed analysis on simulation outcome values. Provides comprehensive statistical analysis including descriptive statistics and percentiles.

tools.name: calculate_value_at_risk
tools.description: Calculate Value at Risk (VaR) from simulation results. VaR is the maximum loss expected with X% confidence.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level (e.g., 0.95 for 95% VaR, 0.99 for 99% VaR). Default: 0.95

tools.name: calculate_probability
tools.description: Calculate probability of outcomes (above, below, or between threshold) from simulation values.

tools.name: sensitivity_analysis
tools.description: Perform single-variable sensitivity analysis. Tests how changes in one input variable affect the outcome by varying it across a range.

baseValue.description: Base (current) value of the input variable

variableRange.description: Range to test the variable. Use ONE of: {"percentChange": 20} or {"min": 80, "max": 120}

calculation.description: Formula using {0} to reference the variable. Example: "{0} * 1.2 - 50000"

steps.description: Number of test points (default: 11). More steps = smoother analysis.

variableName.description: Name of the variable being tested (optional, for display)

tools.name: tornado_analysis
tools.description: Perform tornado (sensitivity) analysis across multiple variables. Ranks variables by their impact on the outcome. REQUIRED STRUCTURE uses an array of variable objects (name, baseValue, lowValue, highValue).

variables.description: Array of variables to test. Each object must have: • name (string) • baseValue (number) • lowValue (number) • highValue (number)

calculation.description: Formula using {0}, {1}, {2}, etc. to reference variables in order. Example: "{0} - {1}"

tools.name: run_stress_test
tools.description: Run stress tests on financial metrics using pre-defined or custom scenarios.

customShocks.description: Custom shocks as percent changes (e.g., {"Revenue": -0.20, "COGS": 0.10}) - only used if scenario is 'custom'

tools.name: calculate_value_at_risk
tools.description: Calculate Value at Risk (VaR) and Conditional VaR (CVaR) from historical returns.

returns.description: Historical returns as decimal values (e.g., 0.08 for 8%)

tools.name: aggregate_portfolio_risk
tools.description: Aggregate VaR across multiple portfolios accounting for correlations. Reveals diversification benefits.

weights.description: Portfolio weights for component VaR (optional, sums to 1.0)

tools.name: calculate_comprehensive_risk
tools.description: Calculate a complete risk profile including VaR, CVaR, Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, drawdown, and tail statistics.

tools.name: newton_raphson_optimize
tools.description: Find the value where a function equals a target using Newton-Raphson method. Perfect for goal seek problems.

expression.description: Mathematical expression where x is the variable to solve for. Use standard operators: +, -, *, /, ^ for power

initialGuess.description: Starting value for the optimization (important for convergence)

tolerance.description: Convergence tolerance (default: 0.0001). Smaller = more precise but slower

tools.name: gradient_descent_optimize
tools.description: Find the maximum or minimum of a multi-variable function using gradient descent. Perfect for profit maximization or cost minimization.

initialValues.description: Initial values for variables as key-value pairs (e.g., {"price": 100, "marketing": 20000})

learningRate.description: Step size for gradient descent (default: 0.01). Smaller = slower but more stable

tools.name: optimize_capital_allocation
tools.description: Allocate limited capital across investment opportunities to maximize total NPV. Uses greedy or optimal integer programming methods.

projects.description: Array of projects with name, cost, and npv fields

method.description: Allocation method: 'greedy' (fast, good) or 'optimal' (exact but slower)

tools.name: optimize_portfolio
tools.description: Find the optimal portfolio allocation using Modern Portfolio Theory (Markowitz optimization). Maximizes the Sharpe ratio.

returns.description: Historical returns for each asset (array of arrays, one per asset)

riskFreeRate.description: Risk-free rate for Sharpe ratio calculation (use same period as returns data)

tools.name: calculate_efficient_frontier
tools.description: Generate the efficient frontier showing all optimal risk-return combinations.

points.description: Number of points to calculate on the frontier (default: 20)

tools.name: calculate_risk_parity
tools.description: Calculate risk parity allocation where each asset contributes equally to portfolio risk. Alternative to mean-variance optimization.

tools.name: price_black_scholes_option
tools.description: Price European options using the Black-Scholes-Merton model. REQUIRED STRUCTURE: Requires type, spotPrice, strikePrice, timeToExpiry, riskFreeRate, volatility.

timeToExpiry.description: Time to expiration in years (e.g., 0.5 for 6 months)

riskFreeRate.description: Annual risk-free interest rate as decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

tools.name: calculate_option_greeks
tools.description: Calculate option Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho) for sensitivity analysis.

tools.name: calculate_binomial_tree_option
tools.description: Price options using binomial tree model (supports American & European options). REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires optionType, americanStyle, spotPrice, strikePrice, timeToExpiry, riskFreeRate, volatility.

americanStyle.description: True for American (early exercise), False for European (expiration only)

steps.description: Number of time steps in binomial tree (default: 100, more steps = more accurate)

tools.name: value_expansion_option
tools.description: Value a strategic expansion option as a call option on growth opportunities. Captures the value of flexibility to expand.

timeToDecision.description: Years until expansion decision must be made

tools.name: value_abandonment_option
tools.description: Value an abandonment option as a put option providing downside protection. Captures the value of being able to exit a project.

salvageValue.description: Value if project is abandoned (resale, salvage)

tools.name: calculate_correlation
tools.description: Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient between two datasets. Measures linear relationship (-1.0 to 1.0).

tools.name: linear_regression
tools.description: Perform linear regression analysis (y = mx + b). Returns slope, intercept, and R².

predictFor.description: Optional: X values to generate predictions for

tools.name: spearmans_correlation
tools.description: Calculate Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (rho). Non-parametric measure of rank correlation.

tools.name: calculate_confidence_interval
tools.description: Calculate confidence interval for a population parameter based on sample data.

values.description: Sample data (use this OR use mean/stdDev/sampleSize)

mean.description: Sample mean (if not providing raw values)

stdDev.description: Sample standard deviation (if not providing raw values)

sampleSize.description: Sample size (if not providing raw values)

tools.name: calculate_covariance
tools.description: Calculate covariance between two datasets. Measures how much two variables change together.

tools.name: calculate_z_score
tools.description: Calculate z-score for testing correlation significance. Quantifies how many standard deviations a correlation is from zero.

tools.name: descriptive_stats_extended
tools.description: Calculate comprehensive descriptive statistics for a dataset (mean, median, std dev, variance, range, percentiles, skewness).

tools.name: hypothesis_t_test
tools.description: Perform a t-test to compare means (two-sample or one-sample) and determine statistical significance. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires sample1, and either sample2 or populationMean.

sample1.description: First sample data (required). Array of numbers.

sample2.description: Second sample data (optional, for two-sample test). Array of numbers.

populationMean.description: Known population mean (optional, for one-sample test). Number.

alpha.description: Significance level (default: 0.05 for 95% confidence). Common values: 0.01, 0.05, 0.10. Example: 0.05

tools.name: hypothesis_chi_square
tools.description: Perform chi-square test for independence or goodness-of-fit. Tests whether observed categorical data differs significantly from expected distributions.

observed.description: Observed frequencies for each category. Array of numbers. Example: [3-5]

expected.description: Expected frequencies for each category. Must be same length as observed. Example: [5, 6]

tools.name: calculate_sample_size
tools.description: Calculate required sample size for statistical significance.

marginOfError.description: Margin of error (0-1). Common values: 0.03 (±3%), 0.05 (±5%), 0.10 (±10%). Example: 0.05

proportion.description: Expected proportion (0-1). Use 0.5 for maximum/conservative estimate. Example: 0.5

populationSize.description: Total population size. Use large number (1000000+) for infinite population. Example: 10000

tools.name: calculate_margin_of_error
tools.description: Calculate margin of error for confidence intervals.

standardDeviation.description: Standard deviation of the sample. Example: 2.5

tools.name: ab_test_analysis
tools.description: Complete A/B test analysis with statistical significance testing. REQUIRED STRUCTURE uses variantA and variantB objects containing 'observations' and 'conversions'.

variantA.description: First variant data. Object with 'observations' (total views/visits) and 'conversions' (successful outcomes). Optional 'name' field for labeling.

variantB.description: Second variant data. Object with 'observations' and 'conversions'. Optional 'name' field for labeling.

tools.name: calculate_p_value
tools.description: Calculate p-value from test statistic (z-score or t-statistic).

testStatistic.description: Test statistic value (z-score or t-statistic). Example: 2.45

tools.name: binomial_probability
tools.description: Calculate the binomial probability mass function (PMF) - the probability of getting exactly k successes in n independent Bernoulli trials. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires n, k, and p.

tools.name: poisson_probability
tools.description: Calculate the Poisson probability - the probability of observing exactly x events in a fixed interval when events occur at a constant average rate. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires x and mu (rate).

tools.name: exponential_distribution
tools.description: Calculate the exponential distribution PDF - models the time between events in a Poisson process. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires x (time) and lambda (rate).

x.description: Value at which to evaluate PDF

tools.name: hypergeometric_probability
tools.description: Calculate the hypergeometric probability - probability of x successes in n draws without replacement from a finite population. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires total, successes_in_population, sample_size, successes_in_sample.

successes_in_population.description: Number of success states in population

tools.name: lognormal_distribution
tools.description: Calculate the log-normal distribution PDF - models data that follows a normal distribution after logarithmic transformation. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires x (value). Mean and StdDev are optional (default 0, 1).

tools.name: calculate_combinations
tools.description: Calculate combinations (n choose r) - the number of ways to choose r items from n items without regard to order.

tools.name: calculate_permutations
tools.description: Calculate permutations (n P r) - the number of ways to arrange r items from n items where order matters.

tools.name: calculate_factorial
tools.description: Calculate the factorial of a number (n!) - the product of all positive integers less than or equal to n.

tools.name: geometric_mean
tools.description: Calculate the geometric mean - the nth root of the product of n numbers. Useful for growth rates and ratios. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires an array of 'values'.

tools.name: harmonic_mean
tools.description: Calculate the harmonic mean - useful for averaging rates and ratios. The reciprocal of the arithmetic mean of reciprocals. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires an array of 'values'.

tools.name: weighted_average
tools.description: Calculate the weighted average (weighted mean) - average where each value has a different weight or importance. REQUIRED STRUCTURE requires parallel arrays for 'values' and 'weights'.

weights.description: Array of weights (same length as values)

tools.name: goal_seek
tools.description: Find the input value that produces a target output using Newton's method. Uses a formula type and coefficients.

coefficients.description: Array of coefficients for the formula

tools.name: data_table
tools.description: Generate a data table showing how output varies with one or two input variables. Similar to Excel's Data Table feature.

tools.name: calculate_bayes_theorem
tools.description: Calculate posterior probability using Bayes' Theorem. Updates the probability of an event based on new evidence.

priorProbability.description: Prior probability P(D) - base rate before new evidence (0 to 1)

truePositiveRate.description: P(T|D) - probability of positive result when event is true (sensitivity, 0 to 1)

falsePositiveRate.description: P(T|¬D) - probability of positive result when event is false (1-specificity, 0 to 1)

testName.description: Optional name for the test/evidence (e.g., 'Medical Test', 'Contains keyword')
